review: Nine at night used to end a particular way. Now it is this album with the lights off. "Anniversary Grief" does not tell me it gets better. It says the date comes around again and you are still here, today. That is the only promise anybody has ever made me that turned out to be true. Five stars. I want to say one more thing. I close anything that promises me a breakthrough. I have been sold that by people who wanted something from me and I can hear it coming now from about four bars out. This album never once tries it. Whoever made it has either been in a room like mine or listened very carefully to somebody who was.
